stops.name: Eng
stops.quote: So just pause for a moment, take in the magnificent nature and pay a visit to the pretty alpine village of Eng!
stops.english: So just pause for a moment, take in the magnificent nature and pay a visit to the pretty alpine village of Eng!

stops.name: Großer Ahornboden
stops.quote: Highlights in the Karwendel Nature Park include the Großer Ahornboden with its old maple trees, the spectacular Karwendel Gorge and the Karwendel Alpine Park, which serves as a visitor centre.
stops.english: Highlights in the Karwendel Nature Park include the Großer Ahornboden with its old maple trees, the spectacular Karwendel Gorge and the Karwendel Alpine Park, which serves as a visitor centre.

stops.name: small Ahornboden
stops.quote: The small Ahornboden, the Karwendel railway with views over Innsbruck and the Isar spring are further sights that will delight nature lovers.
stops.english: The small Ahornboden, the Karwendel railway with views over Innsbruck and the Isar spring are further sights that will delight nature lovers.

stops.name: Hafelekar
stops.quote: The Innsbruck Nordkettenbahnen cable car takes you up to the Hafelekar, where hikers have Innsbruck at their feet on the south side and the nature park on the north side.
stops.english: The Innsbruck Nordkettenbahnen cable car takes you up to the Hafelekar, where hikers have Innsbruck at their feet on the south side and the nature park on the north side.

stops.name: Frau Hitt
stops.quote: A little greeting over to the stone landmark "Frau Hitt" is a must, while the Alpine choughs circle in the updraft.
stops.english: A little greeting over to the stone landmark "Frau Hitt" is a must, while the Alpine choughs circle in the updraft.

stops.name: Mondscheinspitze
stops.quote: You have to be fit to climb the 2,106 metre high Mondscheinspitze.
stops.english: You have to be fit to climb the 2,106 metre high Mondscheinspitze.

stops.name: Halltal valley
stops.quote: The Halltal valley is located to the north of the former salt works town of Hall in Tirol.
stops.english: The Halltal valley is located to the north of the former salt works town of Hall in Tirol.

stops.name: Hinterautal valley
stops.quote: A bike tour through the wild Hinterautal valley is the best way to explore the source of the Isar.
stops.english: A bike tour through the wild Hinterautal valley is the best way to explore the source of the Isar.

stops.name: Isar spring
stops.quote: The small Ahornboden, the Karwendel railway with views over Innsbruck and the Isar spring are further sights that will delight nature lovers.
stops.english: The small Ahornboden, the Karwendel railway with views over Innsbruck and the Isar spring are further sights that will delight nature lovers.
